paite: Huan unaute aw, Masidonia gam a saptuam pawlte lak a Pathian hehpihna piak pen ka hon theisak ding uhi.
heading: Jerusalem Gentheite A Dia Thilpiak
english: Moreover, brothers, we make known to you the grace of God which has been given in the assemblies of Macedonia,

paite: Huchi a haksa thuakna ze-etna thupi a, akipahna uh kiching zou leh nakpi a genthei hinapi, amau lam a athilphalna thupi un huaite khupzou ahihdan bang.
english: how in a severe ordeal of affliction, the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded to the riches of their generosity.

paite: Aneih bang un, ahi, aneih sang ua thupi in leng, amau ut thu un apia uh chih theihpih ka hi;
english: For according to their power, I testify, yes and beyond their power, they gave of their own accord,

paite: hiai hehpihna leh misiangthoute nasepsakna thu a nakpitak a hon ngen ngutngut in.
english: begging us with much entreaty to receive this grace and the fellowship in the service to the saints.

paite: Huan hiai leng ka lamet bang uh hilou, Toupa kiang ah akipekhe masa phot ua, huan Pathian deihna bang in koute kiang ah ahong kipekhia uhi.
english: This was not as we had expected, but first they gave their own selves to the Lord, and to us through the will of God.

paite: Huchi in tuma a apatsa, hiai hehpihna leng noumau a hihkim lai ding in Titas ka ngen uhi.
english: So we urged Titus, that as he had made a beginning before, so he would also complete in you this grace.

paite: Huchi in bangkim ginna, thugen siamna, theihna, phattuamngaihna tengteng, na hon itna uh na hauh bang un, huai hehpihna leng na hauhtheihna ding un thanop suah un.
english: But as you abound in everything—in faith, utterance, knowledge, all earnestness, and in your love to us—see that you also abound in this grace.

paite: Thupia bang in ka gen kei a, midang phattuamngaihna in na itna uh gildan leng chian ding in ka gen ahi zaw hi.
english: I speak not by way of commandment, but as proving through the earnestness of others the sincerity also of your love.

paite: I Toupa Jesu Khrist hehpihna, agentheihna ziak a na hong hauhtheihna ding un hau mahleh noumau ziak ngeingei a ahong gentheih takdan, na thei uhi.
english: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that you through his poverty might become rich.

paite: Huchi in huai ah ka ngaihdan bang ahia ka gen hi; kum khat paita a na hih pat kia uh leng hilou, hih ding a na na lunggulh uh tu in buchingsakta le uchin nou a ding in ahoihpen ahi.
english: I give advice in this: it is expedient for you who were the first to start a year ago, not only to do, but also to be willing.

paite: Huchi in hihpichin ding a kimanna a-om bang in, na neih bang zel ua tangtunna leng a-omtheihna ding in, tu'n ah zaw hihtangtungta un.
english: But now complete the doing also, that as there was the readiness to be willing, so there may be the completion also out of your ability.

paite: Kimanna pen a-om nak photleh mi aneih louhpi hilou in, aneih bang zel a apiak kipahpih tuak ahi.
english: For if the readiness is there, it is acceptable according to what you have, not according to what you don’t have.

paite: Midang agim louh ua, nou na gimna ding un ka chi kei hi.
english: For this is not that others may be eased and you distressed,

paite: Kibatlualna ding in, na hauhna uh tulai in ataksap awnghukna ahong hih a, ahauhna uh leng na taksap awnghukna uh ahong hih sam theihna ding in ka chi ahi zaw, huchi in kibatlualna ahong om thei ding hi.
english: but for equality. Your abundance at this present time supplies their lack, that their abundance also may become a supply for your lack, that there may be equality.

paite: "Akhawm tam in aval in anei kei a, akhawm tawm in leng atasam tuan kei," chih gelh bang in.
english: As it is written, “He who gathered much had nothing left over, and he who gathered little had no lack.”

paite: Huan ke'n nou ka hon awlmoh bang a awlmohna lungtang Titas kiang a pepa Pathian kiang ah kipahthu om hen.
heading: Titas Leh Alawmte
english: But thanks be to God, who puts the same earnest care for you into the heart of Titus.

paite: Ka ngetna uh ahon sansak a; himahleh ka nget ziak kia uh hilou in, ama phatuamngaihna in, amah ut thu in na kiang ua hoh dia pawt ding in akisa hi.
english: For he indeed accepted our exhortation, but being himself very earnest, he went out to you of his own accord.

paite: Unaupa khat toh amah ka hon sawl uhi. Huai unaupa asaptuam un tanchinhoih lam a aphatna uh saptuam pawl tengteng ah athangsuak hi.
english: We have sent together with him the brother whose praise in the Good News is known throughout all the assemblies.

paite: Huchi lel leng ahi kei, hiai hehpihna thawnpiak po ding a kou toh zin vialvial ding a saptuam telkhiak ahi a, Toupa thupina ding in hiai thilthawnpiak ka hawm ua, midangte huh na kithalawpna uh ensak ding in leng ka hawm uhi.
english: Not only so, but he was also appointed by the assemblies to travel with us in this grace, which is served by us to the glory of the Lord himself, and to show our readiness.

paite: Hiai thilpiak ka hawmna lam uah kuamah in ahon demlouhna ding un ka pilvang uhi.
english: We are avoiding this, that any man should blame us concerning this abundance which is administered by us.

paite: Toupa ngaihdan kia in hilou in, mihing ngaihdan a leng thil kilawm ka ngaihtuah khol zel uhi.
english: Having regard for honorable things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.

paite: Huan akiang uah ka unaupa uh ka sawl ua, amah thil tampitak ah phatuamngaitak ahi chih tamveipi ka theichianta uhi, tu khol a houh nou ahon taksan mahmah ziak in phatuam angai nawn sem hi.
english: We have sent with them our brother whom we have many times proved earnest in many things, but now much more earnest, by reason of the great confidence which he has in you.

paite: Titas ahihleh, ka lawm leh noumau lam a ka naseppih ahi a; huan, ka unaute uh ahihleh, saptuam pawlte palai, Khrist thupina ahi uhi.
english: As for Titus, he is my partner and fellow worker for you. As for our brothers, they are the apostles of the assemblies, the glory of Christ.

paite: Huaiziak in na it uh chih theihna leh ka hon suanna uh theihtelna saptuam pawlte ma ah akiang uah langsak un.
english: Therefore show the proof of your love to them before the assemblies, and of our boasting on your behalf.
